The '''Moggonites''' of [[Arorua]] were better known as one of the most obnoxious and treacherous species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were short [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] creatures, standing approximately 1/2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Tales" /> They were able to interbreed with at least one other [[Species/Legends|species]]: [[Gizman|Big Gizz]], the leader of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang, was a Moggonite [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]].<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] experienced a sour encounter with a Moggonite named [[Mosko Bolpa]] on the planet Arorua in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="Tales" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Moggonites first appeared in the short comic "[[Life, Death, and the Living Force]]."<ref name="Tales" /> Big Gizz from ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' was later retconned as a Moggonite hybrid.<ref name="Companion" />
